approved: This bill seeks approval for $4.8 billion in interim appropriations for non‑ordinary annual services, covering five‑twelfths of the estimated 2019‑20 spending, and must be passed before 1 July 2019 to ensure continued program and service delivery.

Appropriation Bill (No. 2) 2019-20 was moved for second reading, seeking $7.4 billion in appropriations, while the Parliamentary Departments bill seeks $162 million, including $127 million for Parliament House maintenance and upgrades to the auxiliary power system and mobile phone antenna.
